definitions.meaning: To bear against, strive against, resist

quotations.old_english: Gif he on ðone geonbyrde ðe hine slóg
quotations.english: if he strove against him who slew him

source_text: ge-onbyrdan; p. de; pp. ed To bear against, strive against, resist :-- Gif he on ðone geonbyrde ðe hine slóg if he strove against him who slew him, L. In. 76; Th. i. 150, 18: L. E. G. 6; Th. i. 170, 13: L. Eth. v. 31; Th. i. 312, 11. v. ge-anbyrdan.
